name: contract-return-names
goal: Returns show descriptive value names beside types/examples; no Throws table when no errors are declared

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Return groups hide names and use a hardcoded return value label; Throws forces keepEmpty. Expected: named return values beside type/example and no table for undeclared errors. Reuse ContractTable; qualify return field names by callable.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing contract and shared browser API scenarios asserted empty Throws tables and never asserted return names. Extend these standard scenarios for declared return row names, modal titles, optional error tables and named-field selection at current/historical scopes.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only a54f3490; immutable red 260236874c687287d5f877b0bf58cb26c2043ffea0353eb90cdecf61d042eff8. Standard API assertions reproduce the missing return value name, with before screenshots. Test fixture passes formatter, lint and size audit before freezing.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 5d823200 reuses ContractTable with named return rows and text-only absence of errors; helper selection retains qualified return names; casing contracts declare kebabCaseText, pascalCaseText, camelCaseText and snakeCaseText.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen inputs, command and environment: red 260236874c687287d5f877b0bf58cb26c2043ffea0353eb90cdecf61d042eff8 at a54f3490, green 2e2e1879673f762481f87de135fc8429d17d3c178117d73f4b08684fd84a1836 at 5d823200. Four SSR tests and three browser widths pass at current/historical revisions, including named-return modal and declared-error table checks.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: 601 web tests, formatting, types, lint and all builds passed. Audit initially found a 221-line test fixture; the comment-only size correction passes formatter/lint/audit and the final frozen regression. Thirteen core/unit-index tests pass; registry has 1308 units, zero errors, 64 existing uncertainties. Current/historical desktop/tablet/mobile API checks pass with inspected before/after screenshots. Live 5688 shows kebabCaseText, matching columns, no empty error table and the correct return example modal, with no browser errors. Root formatting/types/lint/Rust passed; full root check was stopped before broader suites/Electron and is not claimed passing.
